A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the data at fixed-target experiments are consistent with each other and can be described by NRQCD calculations with the color-octet contribution at a level of about 10%.
the color octet contribution to J/psi production is about 1% in pp collisions at 900 GeV and increases to about 10% in pp collisions of 200 GeV.
the data on charmonia hadro-production are well described by the NLO NRQCD calculation with the color octet contribution at the same level as the leading order color singlet contribution.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the color octet contributions in NRQCD can be constrained from the fixed-target experiments, and that they are small in the fixed-target energy region.
